convert_video_model: convert a video classification model from a .pkl blob file to a PyTorch .pth state dict
load_model_blobs: load model weight blobs from a pickle file using the blobs_from_pkl function
copy_conv_weights: copy convolution layer weights from pickle blobs into a PyTorch Conv3d module
copy_batchnorm_weights: copy batch normalization weights, running mean, running var, and bias from pickle blobs
validate_canary_weights: initialize and verify canary NaN weights to ensure all model parameters are properly loaded
